# FX forward curve (`fx-forward-curve` v1)

Forward points by tenor for a pair.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `FXF` · **Identifiers:** `FXF-…` in `curveId`

Open one with `FXF <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: fx-forward-curve
version: 1
description: Forward points by tenor for a pair.
match: { kind: fx-forward-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · FX forward curve, id: $.curveId }
strip:
  - { label: Pair, bind: $.pair }
  - { label: Spot, bind: $.spot, fmt: rate5 }
  - { label: "3M points", bind: $.points3m, fmt: pips1, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: "1Y points", bind: $.points1y, fmt: pips1, tone: sign }
panels:
  - id: points
    kind: line
    title: Forward points (pips)
    key: F2
    rows: $.points
    x: tenor
    y: pips
    fmt: pips1
  - id: outright
    kind: table
    title: Outrights
    rows: $.points
    columns:
      - { label: Tenor, bind: "@.tenor" }
      - { label: Points, bind: "@.pips", fmt: pips1, tone: sign }
      - { label: Outright, bind: "@.outright", fmt: rate5 }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.fxSpot, 'fx-spot')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
